gates.required_evidence: Real C++ decoder accepts bounded options frames and isolates malformed frames
Transformed draw/hit parity; wheel clip; frozen capture; focus and Escape precedence
Stop/restart/removal/namespace close; idle capture exemption; stale revision rejection
Tracking calibration/pose loss, SBS desired/applied/failure, engine backoff and stabilization
Pending until owner readback; errors; persistence survives restart
26s square left of level bar by 12s; pad4s gap4s; maximize/restore preserves modes and placements; never roll capture
gates.limitation: Above-desktop Restore cannot be reached from confined maximized app cursor; approved input extension decision pending

gates.required_evidence: Owner-produced native PNG and MP4: moved/resized/curved/rolled/ultrawide/overlap and both maximize actions

limitations: Sibling acceptance report/validator read and validator tests passed; no integrated acceptance implied
No native capture or live hardware claim
External runtime editors remain enabled: options_runtime_complete is not advertised.
Some async action completion readback and complete per-row native acceptance remain unverified.
Native offline raster PNG/MP4 are not projected GPU or live glasses evidence.
contract: B1+C1 v1 with approved maximize addendum v2
